# Embedded editing source

This directory contains the Python editing MCP, Windows native converter, window helper, shared Skills, host-independent adapters and their tests used by Yoyoking Studio. The derivative includes the source directly, without a submodule, patch reconstruction or sibling checkout. See [the desktop guide](../../YOYOKING.md).

`SOURCE.json` records the imported source revision and the native compatibility fix present in the original working tree. The MIT license in this directory remains intact. Cherry Studio retains its own root AGPL-3.0 license.

Run `pnpm build:yoyoking:native` at the desktop repository root to compile the two native executables and the independent window fixture. Build output, Python environments, account state and media are excluded from Git. The Douyin SDK and Jianying runtime remain external user-provided dependencies.

`yoyoking/` also retains the original Harness plugin source for provenance and regression coverage. Cherry Studio loads only the allowlisted adapters and adapted Skills generated by `scripts/prepare-yoyoking-runtime.mjs`; it does not load the Harness plugin manifest or require Harness to build or run the derivative.
